description: The processing outcome for a single chat attachment. Attachments are processed in the same order as the request's AgentChatRequest.attachments, and one status is returned per attachment in that order.

fileHandleId.description: The file handle id of the attachment.

associateObjectId.description: The ID of the object associated with the file.

associateObjectType.description: The type of object associated with the file.

fileName.description: The resolved name of the file. Null when the file could not be staged.

sessionPath.description: The path where the file was staged in the code interpreter session. Null when the file could not be staged.

contentType.description: The resolved content type of the file. Null when the file could not be staged.

contentSizeBytes.description: The size of the file in bytes. Null when the file could not be staged.

status.description: Whether the attachment was staged into the agent's session.
status.name: AgentChatAttachmentState

enum.name: STAGED
enum.description: The attachment was authorized and loaded into the agent's session.

enum.name: FAILED
enum.description: The attachment could not be loaded.

failureMessage.description: Human-readable failure reason. Null when the status is STAGED.

failureCode.description: The failure code when the status is FAILED. Null when the status is STAGED.
failureCode.name: AgentChatAttachmentFailureCode

enum.name: NOT_FOUND
enum.description: The file handle or associated object could not be found.

enum.name: UNAUTHORIZED
enum.description: The user is not authorized to download the file.

enum.name: EXCEEDS_SIZE_LIMIT
enum.description: The file exceeds the 100 MB per-file limit.

enum.name: UNSUPPORTED_TYPE
enum.description: The file's content type is not one of the approved types (txt, PDF, CSV, JSON).

enum.name: TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS
enum.description: The request exceeded the maximum of 20 attachments.

enum.name: UNKNOWN_ERROR
enum.description: An unspecified error occurred while processing the attachment.
